title: Keep swimming pools behind a child-resistant barrier
what: Keep a complying barrier around each private swimming pool deeper than 300 mm.

sources.title: Building Regulations 2012 (WA)
sources.quote: Each owner and occupier of premises on which there is a private swimming pool containing water that is more than 300 mm deep must ensure that a pool barrier that restricts access to the pool and complies with the requirements of regulation 50A (and, if applicable, regulation 52) is installed or provided around the pool

sources.title: Building Regulations 2012 (WA)
sources.locator: s 53, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current version)
sources.quote: the local government must arrange 1 or more further inspections until an authorised person is satisfied that regulation 50(2) is being complied with.
